en.headline: Observatory forecasts fine and very dry Saturday, windy Sunday for Hong Kong
en.dek: The Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon will bring fine and very dry weather over the weekend, with temperatures from 19 to 26 degrees on Saturday and stronger winds on Sunday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon is expected to bring fine and very dry weather to southern China over the weekend. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas.

On Saturday, the weather will be fine and very dry during the day. Temperatures will range from 19 to 26 degrees Celsius, with relative humidity between 35 and 70 per cent. Winds will be north to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore and up to force 6 on high ground.

On Sunday, it will be mainly fine and dry during the day, with cloudy periods at night. Temperatures are forecast between 19 and 24 degrees Celsius, and relative humidity from 45 to 75 per cent. Winds will be east to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
The Observatory said an easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. No rainstorm or other warnings are currently in force.

zh.headline: 天文台預測周六天晴非常乾燥 周日風勢頗大
zh.dek: 天文台表示，一股達強風程度的東北季候風將在周末為華南帶來晴朗及非常乾燥的天氣，周六氣溫19至26度，周日風勢較大。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股達強風程度的東北季候風預料會在周末期間為華南帶來晴朗及非常乾燥的天氣，內陸地區日夜溫差頗大。
星期六天晴，日間非常乾燥。氣溫介乎攝氏19至26度，相對濕度35至70%。吹北至東北風4級，離岸間中5級，高地達6級。
星期日大致天晴，日間乾燥，晚上部分時間多雲。氣溫介乎19至24度，相對濕度45至75%。吹東至東北風4至5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
天文台指，一股偏東氣流會在下周初至中期影響廣東沿岸。目前沒有暴雨或其他警告生效。
